newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India awards two VLCCs Qua Iboe to Vitol in tender.
newsitem.headline: India awards two VLCCs Qua Iboe to Vitol in tender.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) awarded two very large crude carriers (VLCCs) of Qua Iboe crude oil to trader Vitol London in its April buying tender, traders said on Monday.
The VLCCs were in addition to the two Dubai cargoes awarded in the tender to Total at first-half quotes +42 cents and Phibro at first-half quotes +44 cents.
The tender closed on Thursday and offers were valid until last Friday.
Traders said the VLCCs of Qua Iboe were awarded to Vitol London at dated Brent +88.8 cents and dated Brent +90.8 cents.
